summary: R5.2 Store Credit (Saldo Kredit Pelanggan) - Comprehensive Backend & Frontend Testing Complete
passed_tests: Backend: GET /api/store-credit (summary) - Returns array of customers with non-zero balance
Backend: GET /api/store-credit/balance - Returns balance and by_entity breakdown
Backend: GET /api/store-credit/ledger - Returns ledger entries with type (issue/redeem/adjust)
Backend: GET /api/store-credit/open-orders - Returns open AR orders for customer
Backend: POST /api/store-credit/redeem - Successfully redeems store credit against AR orders
Backend: POST /api/store-credit/adjust - Successfully adjusts balance (+ and -)
Backend: Over-redeem validation - Correctly rejects with 400 when amount > balance
Backend: ISSUE flow - Sales return settled with outcome='store_credit' creates ledger entry and GL credits 2-1450
Backend: Idempotency - Settle store_credit multiple times does not duplicate issue entries
Backend: GL reconciliation - Account 2-1450 (credit-debit) matches sum of ledger balances
Frontend: Store Credit view loads with data-testid='store-credit-view'
Frontend: KPI cards display (sc-kpi-total, sc-kpi-customers, sc-kpi-info)
Frontend: Table displays customer rows with balance (sc-row-<id>)
Frontend: Ledger panel opens and displays entries (sc-ledger-panel, sc-ledger-table)
Frontend: Redeem modal opens with order dropdown and amount input (sc-redeem-modal)
Frontend: Search functionality works (sc-search)
Frontend: Refresh button works (sc-refresh)
Frontend: Empty state displays when no data (sc-empty)
Frontend: StoreCreditBadge component exists and integrated in CheckoutDrawer (data-testid='checkout-store-credit')
POC Test: All 21 tests passed (issue, idempotency, redeem, over-redeem, GL reconciliation)

backend_api_endpoints.GET /api/store-credit: ✅ Returns array of customers with non-zero balance. Empty array when no data.
backend_api_endpoints.GET /api/store-credit/balance: ✅ Returns {balance, by_entity} for customer. Correctly calculates balance from ledger.
backend_api_endpoints.GET /api/store-credit/ledger: ✅ Returns array of ledger entries. Supports filtering by customer_id and entity_id.
backend_api_endpoints.GET /api/store-credit/open-orders: ✅ Returns array of open AR orders for customer to redeem against.
backend_api_endpoints.POST /api/store-credit/redeem: ✅ Successfully redeems store credit. Creates GL entry Dr 2-1450 / Cr 1-1200. Updates order outstanding. Returns applied_amount and redemption number.
backend_api_endpoints.POST /api/store-credit/adjust: ✅ Successfully adjusts balance (positive and negative). Admin/manager only. Creates GL entry and ledger entry.

issue_flow.sales_return_settlement: ✅ When sales return is settled with outcome='store_credit', system correctly: (1) Creates Credit Note, (2) Posts GL entry crediting 2-1450 (NOT 1-1200 Piutang), (3) Creates ledger 'issue' entry, (4) Increases customer balance
issue_flow.idempotency: ✅ Settling same return multiple times does not duplicate issue entries
issue_flow.gl_reconciliation: ✅ GL account 2-1450 balance matches sum of all ledger entries across all entities

frontend_ui.store_credit_view: ✅ Main view loads with all required elements: KPI cards (total, customers, GL account), table with customer rows, search, refresh button
frontend_ui.ledger_panel: ✅ Opens when clicking History button. Displays ledger entries with type badges (Terbit/issue, Pakai/redeem, Sesuai/adjust), amounts, and running balance
frontend_ui.redeem_modal: ✅ Opens from ledger panel. Shows available balance, order dropdown with outstanding amounts, amount input with max button, submit and cancel buttons
frontend_ui.adjust_modal: ✅ Opens for admin/manager. Has plus/minus toggle, amount input, note field
frontend_ui.empty_state: ✅ Displays when no customers have store credit balance > 0
frontend_ui.store_credit_badge: ✅ Component exists at /app/frontend/src/components/StoreCreditBadge.jsx and is integrated in CheckoutDrawer (data-testid='checkout-store-credit'). Shows customer balance when > 0.

validation.over_redeem: ✅ Correctly rejects with HTTP 400 when redeem amount exceeds balance
validation.permissions: ✅ Adjust endpoint requires admin/manager role (ar_receipt:void permission)
validation.data_integrity: ✅ All amounts are properly rounded to 2 decimals. Balance calculations are accurate.

notes: Store credit is a customer liability (GL account 2-1450 'Saldo Kredit Pelanggan')
Store credit is issued when sales returns are settled with outcome='store_credit'
Customers can redeem store credit against open AR orders (from POS, Sales Order, or Invoice)
Admins/managers can manually adjust balances with reason notes
All GL postings are idempotent (source_type + source_id)
Redeem creates GL entry: Dr 2-1450 / Cr 1-1200 (reduces liability and AR)
Issue creates GL entry: Cr 2-1450 (increases liability, part of sales return CN)
Frontend uses Bahasa Indonesia labels throughout
POC test (test_r5_store_credit_poc.py) passed 21/0 tests covering full flow
POS menu not accessible from main navigation (expected per agent note about skipping certain interactions)
